title: Learning Action Models with Conditional and Quantified Effects via Uncertainty-Guided Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2608.30955v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate action models are critical for effective planning. Existing action-model learning methods largely assume simple action representations or become computationally intractable when learning conditional and quantified effects. We present Online Hypothesis-Driven Conditional Action Model Learning (OHCAM), an online approach for learning action models with conditional and quantified effects from limited interactions with the environment. OHCAM maintains a belief over hypothesized action models and actively selects informative actions to reduce uncertainty by maximizing disagreement among competing hypotheses, while being robust to noisy observations. To enable scalability, OHCAM begins with a small set of simple action model hypotheses and expands to more complex conditions only when the current hypotheses become inconsistent with the data. translated_title: 通过不确定性引导的探索学习具有条件效应和量化效应的动作模型
translated_abstract: 准确的动作模型对于有效的规划至关重要。现有的动作模型学习方法大多假设简单的动作表示，或者在学习条件效应和量化效应时变得计算上难以处理。我们提出了在线假设驱动的条件动作模型学习（OHCAM），这是一种通过与环境的有限交互来学习具有条件效应和量化效应的动作模型的在线方法。OHCAM 在假设的动作模型上维护一个信念分布，并通过最大化竞争假设之间的分歧来主动选择信息量大的动作以减少不确定性，同时对带噪声的观测具有鲁棒性。为了实现可扩展性，OHCAM 从一小组简单的动作模型假设开始，仅当当前假设与数据不一致时才扩展到更复杂的条件。在六个基准规划领域的实验表明，OHCAM 在学习准确的动作模型方面具有样本高效性。
tldr: 提出了 OHCAM，一种通过维护竞争假设信念并主动探索以减少不确定性，从而在与环境有限交互中在线学习具有条件效应和量化效应的动作模型的方法，兼具样本高效性与可扩展性。
en_tdlr: OHCAM is an online, sample-efficient method that learns action models with conditional and quantified effects from limited environment interactions by maintaining beliefs over competing hypotheses and actively exploring to reduce uncertainty.
